objectives.label: Say you're returning a book
objectives.descriptorEN: Say you'd like to return this book with 'Rad bi vrnil ___' in the accusative.

objectives.label: Choose how to settle the fee
objectives.descriptorEN: Pay now ('Plačam takoj.') or ask to pay tomorrow ('Lahko plačam jutri?').

objectives.label: Handle the fee & timing
objectives.descriptorEN: Handle a small €2 fee and the word 'jutri' (tomorrow).

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Good day, how can I help?
n1.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Dober dan, izvolite?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dober dan. Rad bi vrnil to knjigo.
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like to return this book.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. To knjigo bi vrnil, prosim.
c1b.en: Good day. I'd like to return this book, please.

n2.speaker: npc
n2.sl: Vidim, da ste malo zamudili. Plačilo je dva evra.
n2.en: I see you're a little late. The fee is two euros.
n2.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Vidim, da ste malo zamudili. Plačilo je dva evra.

n3a.speaker: npc
n3a.en: Thank you. Here's the receipt. Goodbye!
n3a.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] Hvala. Tukaj je potrdilo. Nasvidenje!

n3b.speaker: npc
n3b.sl: V redu. Prosim, plačajte jutri. Nasvidenje!
n3b.deliverySL: [soft spoken, whimsical and a little eccentric young librarian] V redu. Prosim, plačajte jutri. Nasvidenje!
